title: Best ophthalmologists in Buenos Aires
useCase: Routine refraction (control oftalmológico), a new glasses prescription, and daily disposable contact lenses.
workflowNote: In Buenos Aires an oftalmólogo writes the receta; an óptica usually cuts the lenses and fits dailies. Hospital Italiano is the rare one-stop. Everyone else: exam first, then Pförtner or another contactología shop.

criteria.name: Refraction and glasses Rx
criteria.note: Confirmed control visual, same-visit receta, and a path that is not surgery-intake only.

criteria.name: Daily contacts
criteria.note: Published contact-lens fitting, daily disposables, or an on-site óptica that stocks them.

criteria.name: Access
criteria.note: CABA location, booking path, walk-in hours, and wait-time signal.

criteria.name: Reviews
criteria.note: Google and Doctoralia volume and tone, weighted toward routine-care comments rather than surgery testimonials.

criteria.name: English
criteria.note: Official English desk, English-speaking named doctor, or recent English review evidence.

criteria.name: Credentials
criteria.note: Hospital or specialist-clinic standing, teaching, and years in practice.

optica.name: Óptica Pförtner
optica.address: Av. Pueyrredón 1706, Recoleta; also Av. Cabildo 2617, Belgrano
optica.bookingLead: Book a contact-lens trial after you already have an ophthalmologist receta. Trial fitting is listed as free.
optica.consultPriceNote: No public exam fee. Soft-lens trial listed as free; replenishment promos for archived Rx. Expect private/premium pricing.

english.label: English reviews and English replies
english.evidence: Recent English Google reviews; staff replies in English. Official site is Spanish.

medife.label: No Medifé listing found — expect private pay

optica.bestFor: Daily disposables and complex contactología once you already have a receta.
optica.notes: Óptica and contactología chain since 1943, not an MD clinic. Soft lenses include descartables; listed brands include Acuvue, Alcon, Biofinity, Ultra, SofLens. Glasses typically take about a week.
optica.caution: They will not replace an oftalmólogo. Bring a current receta.

places.name: Hospital Italiano — oftalmología
places.address: Perón 4190, Almagro. Consultorios: Perón 4272, 5°. Óptica on the ground floor. San Justo: Av. Pte. Perón 2231.
places.bookingLead: Call 4959-0300 or the patient portal and ask for oftalmología / atención primaria. Book the óptica separately at 4959-0432 after you have the receta. San Justo has a same-day express glasses check.
places.consultPriceNote: No public hospital fee. Private quote via the particular-patient form.

english.label: International desk; routine lane not guaranteed
english.evidence: Departamento de Pacientes Internacionales is multilingual. Routine oftalmología is Spanish-first.

medife.label: Higher Medifé tiers only — confirm cartilla

places.bestFor: One-stop refraction plus on-site óptica that stocks daily disposables.
places.notes: Only ranked hospital with a confirmed in-house óptica and contactología desk. Almagro scheduled consults can take weeks. San Justo express check is for glasses renewal, not a full dilated exam. Demand refractaria at Perón 4190 is only for broken or lost glasses.
places.caution: Long booking waits at Almagro. Google 3.4 from hospital-wide reviews, mostly admin.
places.reviewSignal: Google 3.4★ / 3,584 hospital-wide. Clinical praise, wait-time complaints.

places.name: Hospital Alemán — oftalmología
places.address: Av. Pueyrredón 1640, Recoleta. Oftalmología in the Policlínica.
places.bookingLead: Locals: Tu Portal or 4827-7000, option turnos. Foreigners: email AMI first and ask for a refraction consult plus contact-lens fitting.
places.consultPriceNote: Private fee unpublished. AMI quotes on request.

english.label: Strong — AMI bilingual desk
english.evidence: Atención Médica Internacional is the standard English path for foreigners.

medife.label: Listed prepaga — confirm Oro+ and oftalmología copay

places.bestFor: English-speaking exam in Recoleta, then a partner óptica for frames and dailies.
places.notes: Official service page covers integral vision control. Instagram lists contactología. Partner shops (Optivity, Óptica Gascón, Hipervisión) fill glasses and contacts — not on campus. 24h ophthalmology guardia exists but is not the Rx path.
places.caution: No on-site óptica. Confirm daily-disposable trial lenses when booking.

places.name: Hospital Británico — centro oftalmológico
places.address: Suipacha 732, 4°, Microcentro. Sede central: Perdriel 74, Barracas.
places.bookingLead: Ask for oftalmología consulta and receta de anteojos at 0810-222-2748 or WhatsApp 11-3015-9749. Mention daily-contact adaptation if you want trial lenses.

english.label: Likely — request when booking
english.evidence: British-community hospital with an international-relations coordinator; not guaranteed on every oftalmólogo.

medife.label: Medifé listed on coberturas — confirm plan and authorization

places.bestFor: Central CABA hospital exam with autorefractor and same-visit studies.
places.notes: Diagnostic and laser center opened 2023 at Suipacha 732 with primary-care consultorios (slit lamp, tonometer, autorefractometer). Jefe: Dr. Ezequiel Rosendi. Glasses and contacts go through partner ópticas, including Plan de Salud discounts.
places.caution: Contact-lens fitting is not spelled out on the public site. Google ratings are dragged down by turnos/admin.

places.name: Dra. Mónica Esguerra Hoyos
places.address: Juramento 1475, Piso 5, Depto 2 (Consultorio 502), Belgrano, C1428 CABA
places.bookingLead: Book on Doctoralia — slots are often next-day. Ask for control visual plus lentes de contacto, not only a pediatric check.
places.consultPriceNote: Doctoralia lists primera consulta, sucesivas, and lentes de contacto at ARS 60,000 (Aug 2026).

english.label: Confirmed — site lists English; she replies in English
english.evidence: Official site lists Inglés. May 2026 English review; she replied in English. A patient who did not speak Spanish wrote that she held the visit in English.

medife.label: No Medifé listing — OSDE and Galeno appear; expect private pay

places.bestFor: Belgrano same-visit glasses receta and published contact-lens fitting, with real English and next-day booking.
places.notes: Doctoralia #1 for lentes de contacto in Capital Federal. MN 124058. Adults and children. Reviews mention same-visit glasses changes. Buy frames and dailies at Pförtner or another óptica after the exam.
places.caution: Solo consultorio, no on-site óptica, daily-disposable brands not listed. Pediatric-heavy. Google listing is unclaimed.
places.reviewSignal: Doctoralia 5.0★ / 234. Google Maps unclaimed with no reviews.

places.name: Consultores Oftalmológicos
places.address: Montevideo 1410, Recoleta. Surgical site: Clínica del Golf, La Pampa 1225, Belgrano.
places.bookingLead: Call 2150-2990 or WhatsApp 5815-2725 and ask for a general ophthalmologist. Do not book Dr. Devoto — he is eyelids only.

english.label: Limited — confirm when booking
english.evidence: Clinic site is Spanish. Devoto's Somos Mirada brand has English, but that path is oculoplastics only.

medife.label: Private only — no Medifé listing found

places.bestFor: Premium private comprehensive exam if you will buy lenses elsewhere.
places.notes: Multidisciplinary clinic since 1989. Lic. Carmen Ferraris is on staff as óptica contactóloga, with a published focus on low vision and specialty lenses rather than retail dailies.
places.caution: Devoto / Somos Mirada share the address and are the wrong booking path for glasses or contacts.

places.name: Clínica de Ojos Dr. Nano
places.address: Blas Parera 4201, Olivos. Also San Miguel and Morón. Recoleta Instituto at Marcelo T. de Alvear 1418 is surgery-first.
places.bookingLead: WhatsApp Olivos or the web form. Ask for consulta general plus adaptación de lentes de contacto at a suburban sede, not the Recoleta Instituto.

english.label: International page; in-clinic English unconfirmed
english.evidence: English international-patient page names coordinator Alejandra Sakuda.

medife.label: Not found in public Medifé cartilla

places.bestFor: Named contact-lens service if you can travel to Olivos, San Miguel, or Morón.
places.notes: ISO 9001 suburban network with an official lentes de contacto page (soft and rigid). Lens supply is sent to external ópticas. Recoleta Instituto de Ojos Nano is a related but surgery-centric practice.
places.caution: Olivos waits of 1–2 hours are common. Daily-disposable brands are not listed.

places.name: Charles Centro Oftalmológico
places.address: Riobamba 841 (central). Also Paraguay 1896–1900, Av. Córdoba 1877–1889, Av. Córdoba 1866.
places.bookingLead: Central de turnos 4129-6060 or WhatsApp 3911-5248. Book a consultorio, not the 24h guardia — guardia will not write a glasses Rx.

english.label: English website only
english.evidence: centrocharles.com.ar/en/ exists; no claim that doctors consult in English.

places.bestFor: High-volume Recoleta clinic with Medifé if you only need the medical receta.
places.notes: Legal entity Centro Oftalmológico Dr. Charles S.A., founded 1998. Not Instituto de la Visión and not Clínica Malbrán. Jerónimo Salguero 933 is CIMO, a different clinic. Topography pages mention contact-lens adaptation.
places.caution: Surgery-heavy. Phone holds and scheduling friction show up often in reviews.

places.name: Centro Privado de Ojos
places.bookingLead: Walk in for receta de anteojos, ages 14+, 8:00–21:00 every day. Passport is enough for a traveler Rx per published reviews. Use Docturno or WhatsApp for everything else.
places.consultPriceNote: Official site lists consulta $55,000 ARS from 1 May 2025; guardia $60,000. Confirm before you go.

english.label: Traveler-friendly; no official English site
english.evidence: Published traveler review of a walk-in passport glasses Rx.

medife.label: Medifé not on official cobertura list

places.bestFor: Same-day walk-in glasses prescription. Then take the receta to Pförtner for dailies.
places.notes: Known as the Congreso eye center. Dedicated receta hours daily. No contactología or óptica on the published service list. Accepts OSDE, Swiss Medical, Galeno, Medicus, Omint and others — not Medifé.
places.caution: Peak waits. Steep entry stairs. Posted price may be stale.
places.reviewSignal: Google 3.5★ / 490. Fast Rx praise, reception and wait complaints.

places.name: Centro Lerner
places.bookingLead: WhatsApp 11 4948-8888 or the online portal. Patients 16+ only.

english.label: Doctor-dependent
english.evidence: July 2026 Belgrano Google review: doctor spoke good English. Site is Spanish.

medife.label: Not on official coberturas list — OSDE and Swiss Medical are

places.bestFor: Highly reviewed surgical clinic that can still write a glasses Rx.
places.notes: Outstanding Google volume (4.9★ Recoleta, 5.0★ Belgrano). Positioning is cataract and LASIK. No advertised contact-lens fitting.
places.caution: Some reviews mention surgery upsell. No on-site óptica.

places.name: Consultorios Oftalmológicos Arenales
places.address: Arenales 1446, Piso 1 Depto A, Recoleta. Related suburban site: Av. Gral. Alvear 260, Martínez.
places.bookingLead: Book a general control oftalmológico with graduación online or WhatsApp. Ask for Osvaldo or Gonzalo Gossn — not the refractive-surgery intake.
places.consultPriceNote: Doctoralia lists ARS 50,000 for private primera/sucesiva consulta.

english.label: Both Gossn doctors list English
english.evidence: Doctoralia lists English for Osvaldo and Gonzalo Gossn. Site and booking are Spanish-only.

medife.label: Logo on official site — confirm plan; not on Doctoralia Recoleta profiles

places.bestFor: Recoleta refraction and glasses receta with high review volume; take the receta to Pförtner for dailies.
places.notes: Osvaldo Gossn founded the clinic; Gonzalo is retina. Recoleta page lists control oftalmológico with graduación plus on-site OCT and topography. No published contactología desk.
places.caution: Marketing skews surgical. No on-site fitting or daily-disposable supply. Occasional one-hour waits.
places.reviewSignal: Google 4.8★ / 1,031 Recoleta. Doctoralia 214 clinic opinions; Osvaldo 300; Gonzalo 136.

places.name: Centro Oftalmológico Dr. Andersson
places.bookingLead: WhatsApp or turnos online. Ask for oftalmología general / receta de anteojos, not cirugía refractiva intake.
places.consultPriceNote: No public fee. Particular pay and listed prepagas; quote via WhatsApp.

english.label: Spanish-only
english.evidence: Site, reviews, and Trustpilot are Spanish. Dr. Andersson is Hospital Británico / AAO faculty, but no English desk or review evidence.

medife.label: Not on official coberturas — OSDE, Swiss Medical, Medicus listed instead

places.bestFor: High-trust Recoleta refraction and glasses receta if you already have OSDE or Swiss Medical.
places.notes: Oftalmología general page lists refracción, graduación, and receta de lentes. Nine MDs. Dr. Pablo Andersson: 35+ years, ~28 years Hospital Británico staff.
places.caution: Surgery-forward brand. No published contact-lens adaptation. Tuesday afternoons are peak.

places.name: Instituto de la Visión (Dr. Daniel Badoza)
places.bookingLead: Appointment only. WhatsApp 11 5572-2763, phone 6091-2900, or Doctoralia for Badoza.
places.consultPriceNote: Doctoralia private primera consulta from ARS 70,000 (2026).

english.label: Badoza speaks English; clinic-wide English unconfirmed
english.evidence: Doctoralia and lamejorvision.com list Inglés for Dr. Badoza.

medife.label: Medifé on official coberturas; Badoza’s own slot is more limited

places.bestFor: High-complexity refraction and same-visit diagnostics with a named English-speaking surgeon.
places.notes: Specialty eye hospital since 1986. Badoza is director médico. Patient reviews mention leaving with a glasses receta the same day. Not a retail óptica. OSDE and Swiss Medical are not on the official Instituto list.
places.caution: No confirmed contact-lens fitting. Mixed Google 4.0★ / 545 on waits and billing.

places.name: Centro de Ojos Buenos Aires — Manzitti
places.address: Azcuénaga 1677, Barrio Norte. Also Av. Córdoba 487 1A, Retiro; Av. Callao 1059 13B.
places.bookingLead: Appointment required for glasses or LC Rx. WhatsApp 11 3098-1677. Walk-in demanda espontánea will not prescribe lenses.
places.bestFor: Scheduled full exam and Rx renewal at a long-running Barrio Norte clinic.
places.notes: Since 1981. Site note: no glasses or LC prescriptions on walk-in. Reviews mention recurring glasses and LC renewals.
places.caution: Do not use demanda espontánea for this use case.

places.name: SOF Buenos Aires (Dr. Jeremías Galletti)
places.address: Av. Triunvirato 3176, 1°, Villa Ortúzar. Galletti also at Arenales 2245, 4°, Recoleta.
places.bookingLead: Clinic WhatsApp 11 6605-9780, or Doctoralia for Galletti if you specifically want him.
places.consultPriceNote: Galletti private consult ARS 40,000 at SOF (Aug 2026).

english.label: Galletti English and German
english.evidence: Doctoralia lists Inglés and Alemán; personal site has a full English version.

medife.label: Medifé listed on clinic obras sociales

places.bestFor: English-speaking high-complexity ophthalmologist if you already know you need more than a routine Rx.
places.notes: Clinic publishes computerized glasses refraction. Galletti is retina and cataract — overkill for dailies. Federico Karp / oftalmología Colegiales is a different practice.

places.name: Clínica Oftalmológica Malbrán
places.bookingLead: Web form or 4819-4200. Guardia walk-in 8:00–20:00 daily, but reviews warn about that path.
places.consultPriceNote: No current public fee. A 2023 review cited ~ARS 10,800 — treat as outdated.

english.label: Spanish-first
english.evidence: Website and booking form are Spanish-only.

medife.label: Medifé logo on homepage; not in the booking dropdown

places.bestFor: Historic Malbrán-family clinic if you need complex disease care, not a first glasses-and-dailies visit.
places.notes: FAQ discusses daily disposable lenses supervised by a contactólogo. No on-site óptica. Polarized reviews.
places.caution: Google 3.2★ with frequent wait and front-desk complaints.

places.name: Instituto Zaldivar
places.bookingLead: WhatsApp +54 9 261 554-0755. This is a surgical workup, not a walk-in Rx.

medife.label: Listed on convenios — confirm sede and plan

places.bestFor: LASIK, SMILE, ICL, or cataract — not this ranking’s use case.
places.notes: Newsweek LATAM #1 private ophthalmology clinic, 2026. BA site is operating-room first. Specialty scleral lenses for keratoconus only.
places.caution: Poor fit for a glasses update or daily contacts.

places.name: Oftalmos
places.address: Av. Córdoba 1830, inside the Otamendi-Miroli complex
places.bookingLead: Phone 4816-9100. Recent reviews say the phones often go unanswered.

english.label: Expat-blog English mention
english.evidence: Salud y Vos lists English-speaking staff; director trained at Cornell and Duke.

medife.label: Historical Medifé listing; not confirmed on current site

places.bestFor: Academic retina and cataract — not a routine glasses-and-dailies visit.
places.notes: Founded 1999. Refraction column on site. No dedicated contact-lens service page. No online turnos.
places.caution: Google 3.1★ / 302 with chronic phone and upsell complaints.
